packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textfacts
packages.scope: Deterministic single-text kernel. Legacy broad public subpaths are frozen; new cross-package growth does not land here.
limitations: New cross-package protocol/resource/schema/tooling growth is frozen outside textfacts
Locale tailoring breadth remains limited

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textdoc
packages.scope: Public alpha document container package for raw-text document creation, document identity, source/token/sentence views, lifecycle, provenance, annotation-layer validation, and package-level graph integrity checks proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1 and package tests.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Task-specific graph semantics remain limited beyond package-level graph integrity checks.
Alpha scope is bounded to document/container behavior and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textpack
packages.scope: Public alpha text resource package for manifest validation, fixture resource loading, deterministic registry queries, overlay precedence, provenance, licensing, and lookup diagnostics proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1 and package tests.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Multilingual pack coverage and update workflow are not broad enough for package release.
No public resource marketplace or vetting workflow is implemented
Alpha scope is bounded to explicit fixture resources and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textrules
packages.scope: Public alpha deterministic rules package for reusable lexical token-pattern primitives and bounded resource-backed rule execution over frozen slices.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Rule-backed behavior remains frozen-slice only for POS, NER, dependency parsing, relation extraction, and coreference.
External comparator captures and corpus evaluation are incomplete for several implemented task surfaces.
Alpha scope is bounded to reusable rules, explicit resources, package tests, and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textpipeline
packages.scope: Public alpha deterministic local pipeline package for synchronous, asynchronous, batch, stream, cancellation, caller-provided cache-hit tracing, and continue-on-error execution hooks.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Remote orchestration, durable cache policy, worker execution, and long-running recovery semantics are not release-ready.
Alpha scope is bounded to deterministic local execution, package tests, and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textcorpus
packages.scope: Public alpha corpus package for explicit-token collections, metadata slicing, deterministic fingerprint indexing, frozen-scope TF-IDF/BM25 scoring, and frozen-scope retrieval fixtures.
limitations: Retrieval and corpus scoring remain frozen-corpus only without external relevance datasets, streaming retrieval, or durable index storage.
Alpha scope is bounded to explicit-token corpus APIs, frozen retrieval fixtures, package tests, and package dry-run evidence

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textprotocol
packages.scope: Public alpha result-envelope package for schema version 1, supported-version negotiation, deterministic JSON transport, and bounded package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Only result-envelope schema version 1 and the package JSON transport wrapper are standardized
Alpha scope is bounded to package interop and external installability proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textconformance
packages.scope: Public alpha conformance report package for machine-readable reports, runtime guards, report diffs, deterministic Markdown rendering, claim-registry traceability checks, and synchronous checks proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1 and package tests.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Benchmark runner is not release-ready.
Alpha scope is bounded to declared conformance reports and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

packages.name: @ismail-elkorchi/textlab
packages.scope: Public alpha inspection package for support-status, task-evidence, conformance-report, annotation, evidence-replay, and corpus-fixture inspection APIs and CLI commands proven by package tests and Public Vertical Slice 0.1.
evidence: Public Vertical Slice 0.1 external-consumer smoke test
limitations: Inspection tooling lacks comparator execution, interactive views, large-corpus browsing, and release-oriented CLI hardening.
Alpha scope is bounded to deterministic inspection APIs, CLI commands, package tests, and package interop proven by Public Vertical Slice 0.1

tasks.scope: Frozen fixtures, expected outputs, comparator captures, and executable behavior are present for the current slices.
evidence: comparator captures and explicit not-run gap records
limitations: Not a broad multilingual tokenizer benchmark suite
Newer script-family fixtures with not-run comparator entries are expected-output evidence, not comparator-backed evidence
nextEvidenceTierBlockers: Corpus-scale tokenization/SBD aggregate outputs and conformance reports are not yet persisted.
Holdout slices exist only as a gate policy and are not sufficient for broad multilingual claims.
Comparator execution still depends on local availability of pinned external tools.

tasks.scope: The document model, invalid-reference policy, lifecycle/provenance support, fixture-level graph annotation conventions, and round-trip validation are implemented.
limitations: Graph conventions are slice-proven for committed fixtures only; broad relation extraction, coreference resolution, entity linking, parser behavior, and confidence/loss conventions remain future work
nextEvidenceTierBlockers: No external document-model comparator or broad graph holdout suite is recorded.

tasks.scope: Resource-manifest validation, licensed fixtures, deterministic registry queries, fixture content loading, and overlay-conflict policy are implemented.
limitations: No public resource review workflow or broad resource marketplace is implemented
nextEvidenceTierBlockers: No external resource-manifest comparator, public review workflow, or broad resource catalog evidence is recorded.
